reason: In contentpreview.edit.js the keyup handler's parameter is still named 'event' but the new code references the undefined variable 'e', causing a ReferenceError that will silently break the live content-preview refresh-on-typing feature in the admin UI (bug is baked into src, dist, min and map files, so it wasn't caught before commit).
